summary: IGC Pharma filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of 2,226,475 shares to CEO Ram Mukunda and 2,048,378 shares to VP/PFO Claudia Grimaldi at $0.27 per share, in exchange for the cancellation of $1,154,210 in outstanding obligations including personal cash advances. The transaction was approved by independent directors and the Audit Committee under Rule 16b-3, involved no cash proceeds, reduced liabilities, and increased equity. Shares were issued in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) as restricted securities. This is a debt-for-equity swap with insiders, not a special situation like a capital return or going-private; it is an ordinary financing/compensation arrangement.
